scripts.generate: pnpm run generate:schema && pnpm run generate:typescript
scripts.check:generated: pnpm run check:schema && pnpm run generate:typescript && git diff --exit-code -- sdk/typescript/packages/contracts/src/generated && status=$(git status --porcelain -- sdk/typescript/packages/contracts/src/generated) && if [ -n "$status" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$status"; exit 1; fi
